Package persist.api.spi

Interface PersistenceServiceProvider

All Known Subinterfaces:
HibernateEnhancerProvider, NamedObjectParserFactory, PersistenceLinterFactory, SchemaValidatorFactory
All Known Implementing Classes:
JakartaHibernateEnhancerProvider, JakartaNamedObjectParserFactory, JakartaPersistenceLinterFactory, JakartaPersistenceServiceProvider, JakartaSchemaValidatorFactory, LegacyHibernateEnhancerProvider, LegacyNamedObjectParserFactory, LegacyPersistenceLinterFactory, LegacyPersistenceServiceProvider, LegacySchemaValidatorFactory
public interface PersistenceServiceProvider
Root service-provider interface for all persistence tool providers.

Each provider declares the JPA namespace it supports (e.g. "jakarta" or "javax") via getSupportedNamespace(). Concrete subtypes such as HibernateEnhancerProvider and PersistenceLinterFactory are discovered at runtime through the ServiceLoader mechanism.

The static helper getServiceProvider(String, Class) maps a JPA specification version string to the corresponding namespace and locates the matching provider from the service loader.

Since:
1.0.0

    • getServiceProvider

      static <T extends PersistenceServiceProvider> T getServiceProvider(String jpaVersion, Class<T> providerClass)
      Discovers and returns the PersistenceServiceProvider of the requested type whose namespace matches the given JPA specification version.

      The version string is mapped to a namespace as follows:

      • "2.0", "2.1", "2.2" → "javax"
      • "3.0", "3.1", "3.2" → "jakarta"
      Type Parameters:
      T - the provider type
      Parameters:
      jpaVersion - the JPA specification version (e.g. "3.1")
      providerClass - the provider subtype to look up
      Returns:
      the matching provider instance
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if jpaVersion is not recognised
      IllegalStateException - if no registered provider matches the resolved namespace
